known_limitations: State is in-memory and resets when the process restarts.
This first release implements a simplified subset of the reviewed requirements, focusing on core browsing, cart, checkout, payment, and basic admin/product management.
Advanced workflows such as file import, customer account lifecycle automation, multi-warehouse inventory, and complex review queues are not implemented.
Payment processing is simulated through a trusted-provider style endpoint and does not integrate with a real payment gateway.
